question: Air _________ on heating and ______ on cooling.
solution:
The correct answer is __**expands, contracts.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Air expands on heating: **

 
 
• When air is heated, its molecules gain energy and move faster, which causes them to spread out and take up more space, leading to expansion.
